description:
Who shipped more today? Committed ranks you against your friends and teammates by GitHub Contributions.

Connect GitHub and your board fills in: you, the people you follow, and the members of your GitHub organizations. They don't need Committed to show up.

THE BOARD
• Everyone ranked by Contributions, the count behind the green squares on a GitHub profile.
• Switch the Window between Today, 7 days and 30 days.
• Chevrons show who moved today. Your summary shows how many Contributions it takes to pass the person ahead.
• Streaks show how many days in a row each person has contributed.
• When someone's contribution count jumps unusually fast between refreshes, the board can mark it with a troll badge.
• Pin up to 3 rivals. They sit at the top of the Board with the gap to each one and your weekly record against them.
• On a day you set a new best, a record card tops the Board.
• Tap anyone to open their person view: your race with them over 30 days, your weekly record over the last 12 weeks, their month day by day, their streak and active days.
• Your own view keeps your records from the past year: best day, best week, longest streak, days at #1 and more.
• Pull to refresh. While the app is open, the board refreshes about every 5 minutes.

LIVE RANK
Keep your rank in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, with the people just above and below you. Pick its Window in Settings.

WIDGETS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your rank and the people around you. They refresh themselves about every 15 minutes and show how long ago they last updated.
• The Committed Board widget lists the leaders. It's made for StandBy.

SHARE
• Share the board as an image of its widget, sized for a square post or a story.
• Open anyone's profile and tap Share to get a face-off image: you and them side by side on Today, 7 days or 30 days, contributions only.

PEOPLE
Search everyone on your board and hide anyone you don't want to race. Hidden people stay in People, so you can show them again. Hiding someone doesn't change who you follow on GitHub.

NOTIFICATIONS
Even with Committed closed, get a notification when you pass someone or someone passes you, about everyone or just your pinned rivals. Turn on more if you want them:
• Close calls, when you're a few contributions behind someone.
• Yesterday's finish each morning, and last week's final on Mondays.
• New records, and a streak reminder in the evening.
Passes arrive right away. Everything else can wait for one summary at 9 PM. Quiet hours (10 PM to 8 AM by default) keep Committed silent overnight.

CHALLENGE A FRIEND
Send anyone on your board your 30-day race as a story image and a link. The link opens a page with the race from their side, no app needed.

TRY A SAMPLE BOARD
Look around before you connect. The Sample board runs the whole app on built-in sample data, with no GitHub account.

WHAT GITHUB ACCESS IT NEEDS
• Connect GitHub uses GitHub's device flow: you approve a code on github.com.
• Committed asks for read-only access to your profile, who you follow and your organizations (read:user and read:org).
• It never asks for repository access or reads your code.
• Your GitHub token stays in your iPhone's Keychain and goes only to GitHub. There's no Committed account.
• Contributions come from each person's public contribution graph. Private contributions count only when that person turns them on in GitHub.

PRIVACY
• No ads, analytics or crash reporting.
• To keep Live rank current and send notifications while the app is closed, the Committed relay receives your GitHub username, the usernames on your board, Live rank's Window, your time zone, your notification choices, your pinned rivals and push tokens. It never receives your GitHub token. Turning off Live rank and every notification deletes what it holds for your iPhone.

Committed is free. It compares activity counts, not code quality or work performance.
promotionalText: See who shipped more today. Committed ranks you against friends and teammates by GitHub Contributions, with Live rank in the Dynamic Island and widgets.
whatsNew: Share a face-off. Open anyone's profile, tap Share, and pick Today, 7 days or 30 days to get an image of your contributions side by side. Choose Square or Story, or switch to someone else on your board.
